RESEARCH_ONLY_LOCAL_BEST_IN_TESTED_POOL (four genuine swaps; below the five-swap owner-presentation floor, so NOT owner-presentable). +Lizard Blades +Giantfall +Sink into Stupor // Soporific Springs +Fell the Profane // Fell Mire / -Fellwar Stone -Rapid Hybridization -Exotic Orchard -Takenuma, Abandoned Mire. No owner keep or owner addition is cut. Lands 38 -> 36 plus two MDFC lands; U/B/R land sources 25/27/24 -> 25/26/23 (MDFC back faces counted); Spellbook complete combos 3 -> 3. Garza castable by turn 6 on the play 0.4724 -> 0.4451 with MDFCs played as lands (0.4073 if never played as lands). Game Changers 9 -> 9. MODERATE confidence; bounded combat ledger only, no matched games.

REJECT_LARGER_PACKAGE (five-swap, staged for transparency only). The research four plus +Nibelheim Aflame/-Nova Flame. Rejected and NOT counted: Nova Flame is the owner's explicit addition (replacing Waltz of Rage because it 'can start at four mana, permanently grows Garza first'); Nibelheim's damage-sourced sweep does not put X permanent counters on Garza, so the evidence does not clearly beat the owner keep.

REJECT_LARGER_PACKAGE (five-swap, staged). +Nibelheim Aflame over Toxic Deluge. Rejected: Toxic Deluge is part of the owner-kept premium interaction shell, answers indestructible/protected boards Nibelheim cannot, and Nibelheim would make the deck's third Garza-sourced sweeper alongside Chandra's Ignition and Nova Flame.

REJECT_LARGER_PACKAGE (five-swap, staged). +Fire Whip over Pongify. Rejected: the owner removed the pinger class (Viridian Longbow / Gorgon's Head), and Fire Whip's 1-damage ping only grows Garza against X/1s.

REJECT_LARGER_PACKAGE (five-swap, staged). +Hammer of Nazahn over Talisman of Indulgence. Rejected: Hammer is a 4-mana non-Garza threat-protection piece that free-attaches later Equipment, but cutting a 2-mana rock drops turn-6 Garza castability 0.4451 -> 0.4179 (MDFC as land); not clearly better.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (four-swap, staged). Same package with Fireshrieker (Pass C's named double-strike piece) instead of Lizard Blades. Identical combat rows in the bounded test; Fireshrieker costs 5 setup mana vs 4 and is not a creature, so it dodges creature removal but cannot carry a Sword itself.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (four-swap, staged). Cuts Inquisitor's Flail instead of Fellwar Stone for Lizard Blades. Keeps baseline castability (0.4724 by turn 6 with MDFCs as lands) but loses the Flail+Lizard Blades 4x hit (24 commander damage at power 6 in the bounded test).

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (one-swap, staged; the exact Pass C requested test on the baseline). Bounded result: Fireshrieker and Inquisitor's Flail give equal one-hit commander damage (10 at power 5), but double strike gives 2 Garza draws, 6 Curiosity draws with Kediss, Spike to 6 life (vs 15), and survives a non-first-strike 5/5 blocker, while Flail dies to it. Not primary: Lizard Blades is the cheaper double-strike piece and keeping Flail beside it gives the 4x hit.
